content: iOS Safari has several important limitations for web applications: storage limits (IndexedDB ~500MB with permission, localStorage 5MB), performance constraints (JS throttled in background, limited memory allocation), restricted features (limited WebGL, Service Workers limited in PWAs), strict security policies (CSP enforcement, same-origin policy, sensor access requires HTTPS), and UX constraints (no native UI, address bar visible, limited PWA features like push notifications). Testing on real devices is essential due to iOS-specific behaviors.
